messages:
Alex P.: Quick async on Evergreen Health private rollout — planned cutover Wed 03:00 UTC. Running list of potential blockers: inbound firewall rules to their bastion, signed image transfer into their airgap repo, HSM/KMS key handoff. Who owns each item? cc @Riley (Platform) @Samir N.

Riley (Platform): I can own orchestration + preflight checklist. Samir — can you confirm the customer CIDR and whether they're expecting SNAT or 1:1 NAT? Also need to know the maintenance window for security team changes.

Samir N.: CIDR they provided: 10.240.0.0/18. They want SNAT for outbound to our updater, but inbound we need explicit allow on the bastion IP range: 10.240.5.0/28. Security window is Tue 22:00–23:30 UTC. I can push the SG change in that window.

Meera K.: For airgap: Evergreen asked for a signed tarball we can hand off. Plan is to produce a gzipped image and MD5+SHA256 checksums. I'll prepare a transfer manifest. Do we have the offline upload contact?

Jon D.: HSM note — Evergreen requires keys be provisioned into their HSM and not exported. We need to provide a CSR for their ops team to sign and load. Who on infra will generate the CSR and document the steps? Also, confirm if we should use separate keys per environment.

Samir N.: SG rule snippet (security group on their side) they asked for:
```
Type: TCP
Ports: 22, 443, 8200
Source: 10.240.5.0/28
Description: Redwood private cutover bastion
```
I'll open the request ticket now and tag security reviewers.

Riley (Platform): Preflight command for their admin to run once network is in place:
```
curl -sS -D - https://internal-verify.redwood.local/health | head -n 20
openssl s_client -connect bastion.evergreen:443 -servername bastion.evergreen
```
If both return 200 and TLS handshake succeeds we mark network OK.

Meera K.: Airgap transfer steps for artifacts:
1) We build: `tar -czf redwood-evg-2026-03.tar.gz ./images/`
2) Sign: `gpg --default-key infra@redwood.com --detach-sign redwood-evg-2026-03.tar.gz`
3) Generate checksums: `sha256sum redwood-evg-2026-03.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS`
4) Provide files to Evergreen ops via secure USB or sftp appliance.
Please confirm contact and whether they accept GPG signatures.

Samir N.: Evergreen ops contact: lucy.w@evergreen.health (confirmed). They require GPG-signed artifacts.

deploy-bot: Checklist updated by Riley (Platform): network_rules:pending -> scheduled; artifact_signed:false -> true; hsm_csr:pending. See runbook v2 at https://runbook.internal/redwood/private-cutovers/evergreen. :gear:

Jon D.: I'll take HSM CSR generation. Plan: generate CSR on an airgapped keygen host, provide CSR to Evergreen, they sign inside their HSM and provide cert blob. I'll document steps and add to the runbook.

Alex P.: Great. Action owners summary: Riley — preflight + orchestration; Samir — firewall change and security ticket; Meera — artifact build + signing; Jon — HSM CSR. I'll update the runbook and schedule a 15m pre-cutover sync Tue 21:30 UTC. If anyone needs a different time say now. :thumbsup:

Samir N.: noted. Scheduling the SG change ticket for Tue 22:05 UTC.

Meera K.: prepping artifact today, will post S3 presigned link + checksums here when ready.

Riley (Platform): I'll post the final preflight checklist and flip the calendar invite to include Evergreen ops.

Alex P.: thanks all — keeping this thread for async updates. If you hit blockers, ping here and I'll escalate.
